query:
WITH RECURSIVE down (id, level) AS (
               SELECT id, 0 FROM pages WHERE id = $1
             UNION ALL
               SELECT c.id, d.level + 1
               FROM down d JOIN pages c ON c.parent_id = d.id
               WHERE d.level < $2
           )
           SELECT COALESCE(max(level), 0) AS "height!" FROM down
